items.title: Is T-Mobile US (TMUS) Trading At A Discount To Its Earnings?
items.summary: T-Mobile US has climbed over the years into one of the largest U.S. wireless players, yet its recent share price swings leave a clear question for you as an investor: Is the current valuation of T-Mobile US, at around US$171 per share, adequately grounded in the earnings the business is generating today? Over the past 5 years, T-Mobile US has delivered a share price gain of 53.8%, which puts real weight on whether its current earnings base can support that kind of long term wealth creation...

items.title: Musk Says SpaceX “Could Just Acquire That Legacy Telco.” AT&T and Verizon Own What He Wants
items.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk said SpaceX “could just acquire” a legacy telco to use its spectrum, after Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile reportedly turned down SpaceX’s requests to run on their networks. Musk’s comment shows that the spectrum AT&T and Verizon own is the asset SpaceX wants.
